evidence.title: [Sinphar Pharmaceutical FY2026 H1 Earnings Call] Gross Margin Hits Record 45.4%, August Revenue Surges 21.6% YoY; NT$700 Million Yilan Smart Logistics Center Aims to Capture Japan
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Vice President Chen Chih-Hsiao spent nearly an hour repeating the message he most wanted to convey this year: "Both the gross margin trend and the revenue trend are showing a steady upward trajectory." Behind that statement are hard numbers. ### Gross Margin of 45.4%: Profit Structure Continues to Evolve In the first half of 2026, Sinphar's consolidated gross margin reached 45.4%, a jump of 2.65 percentage points from 42.7% in the same period of 2025. [e001:f02] He singled out two projects that have absorbed decades of investment — Cistanche tubulosa extract and the plant peptide series: "These are patented and award-winning projects into which Sinphar has poured decades of R&D resources. [e001:f03] But Chen hinted during the call that these expenditures represent "upfront costs for future profitability": Sinphar is preparing for Japanese orders, ASEAN market registrations, and new dosage-form capacity expansion. ### August Revenue Up 21.6% YoY: Growth Momentum Reignited The revenue side delivered equally encouraging news. [e001:f04] Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$2.29 billion (approximately $72.1 million), up 5.83% year-over-year. [e001:f05] For a legacy pharmaceutical company transitioning toward a higher-value product portfolio, this carries more significance than top-line growth alone. ### NT$700 Million Poured into Yilan; Chen: "New Plant Construction Plus Certification Takes at Least Two Years" The centerpiece of the earnings call was Sinphar's formal announcement of the Yilan site expansion. [e001:f06] The largest single investment is the Smart Logistics Center, totaling approximately NT$700 million (approximately $22.0 million), planned at over 30 meters in height and spanning nearly 1,200 ping (approximately 3,967 square meters), integrating a GDP-compliant smart warehousing system and reserved plant space. [e001:f07] Chen described the timing of this investment as "advance planning." When pressed by analysts on why the company is investing in reserved plant capacity now, he offered a pragmatic answer: > "New plant construction plus certification will conservatively take at least two years. [e001:f08] Taking everything into consideration, we are investing at this juncture on top of our existing foundation to meet overall future development needs." He further highlighted a structural industry opportunity: PIC/S regulatory requirements are becoming increasingly stringent, and many manufacturers both in Taiwan and abroad are exiting because their base volumes are insufficient to justify continued investment, with marginal returns steadily diminishing. [e001:f09] "Sinphar has this opportunity — on our existing foundation, we can produce enough volume and recoup our own investment, so we decided to expand further." This logic is critical in the biopharmaceutical industry. [e001:f10] The construction cost of sterile manufacturing and high-specification facilities easily runs into hundreds of millions of New Taiwan dollars. [e001:f11] Without existing capacity to amortize against, new entrants would find it nearly impossible to recover their investment. [e001:f12] Sinphar's quiet investment is, in essence, raising the industry's barriers to entry. ### Japan Collaboration in Focus: Oncology Drug Already Shipping, New GI Drug Distribution Rights Signed Analysts pressed repeatedly on the Japan collaboration during the Q&A session. [e001:f13] Chen revealed several concrete developments: the oncology drug contract manufacturing export agreement has entered the delivery phase, and Chairman Lee Yi-Ta signed a Taiwan distribution rights agreement for a gastrointestinal drug at the CPHI Japan exhibition in April this year. [e001:f14] He expressed strong optimism about the newly signed distribution rights, citing hard data on demand: "According to Taiwan。

evidence.title: Sovereign Investment Institutions Launch China-ASEAN Joint Investment Council
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (Diperbadankan) (KWAP) of Malaysia also joined CAJIC. [e002:f02] Convened by CIC with CGS International Securities Pte. [e002:f03] Ltd. ("CGS International"), the overseas arm of China Galaxy Securities ("CGS"), as Secretariat, CAJIC is a sovereign-to-sovereign investors platform to connect capital, knowledge and leadership across China and ASEAN through regular dialogue, annual forums, themed research, and executive training programs. [e002:f04] CAJIC is intended to provide a dedicated institutional platform through which long-term investors can deepen mutual understanding, develop cross-border investment opportunities, and form a more robust and sustainable China-ASEAN investment ecosystem. [e002:f05] CIC places great importance on cooperation with the sovereign investment institutions in the region to strengthen the cross-border investment ecosystem and promote two-way investment. [e002:f06] Regular dialogue and joint research can reduce information gaps, deepen understanding of local markets, and help institutions identify where their mandates and capabilities align. [e002:f07] Over time, this can strengthen investment pipelines and build trusted partnerships that extend beyond individual transactions. [e002:f08] Ultimately, CAJIC's value will lie in its ability to connect institutions, ideas, and opportunities, and translate them into investment collaboration that creates enduring value for China, ASEAN, and our respective stakeholders." Israfil Mammadov, CEO of SOFAZ, said, "For SOFAZ, CAJIC is a natural extension of our approach to building long-term partnerships with leading sovereign institutions and deepening our engagement across an increasingly important investment corridor. [e002:f09] The Council provides a valuable forum for peer institutions to exchange perspectives, strengthen relationships and explore areas of practical cooperation. [e002:f10] We look forward to contributing SOFAZ's experience and perspective while developing partnerships that can create long-term value." Dr Soraphol Tulayasathien, Secretary-General of GPF, said, "As a long-term institutional investor, GPF sees growing opportunities across the China–ASEAN corridor, particularly in sustainable infrastructure, digitalization, advanced manufacturing and the low-carbon transition. [e002:f11] We look forward to turning shared knowledge into sound long-term investment decisions, supported by strong governance and disciplined risk management." Dato' Amirul Feisal Wan Zahir, Managing Director of Khazanah, said, "Khazanah is honoured to be part of the China-ASEAN Joint Investment Council, which comes at an important time for our region. [e002:f12] China and ASEAN are already deeply connected through trade, investment and supply chains, and the next phase of growth will require sustained dialogue, trusted partnerships and disciplined long-term capital. [e002:f13] Through CAJIC, we look forward to working with like-minded institutions to strengthen regional connectivity, deepen investment collaboration and support long-term prosperity across China and ASEAN." Wang Sheng, Chairman of CGS, said, "CAJIC extends CGS International's work in the China-ASEAN corridor from capital deployment through CAIP launched earlier this year, into the wider institutional platform where sovereign investors across the region can convene, research and collaborate. [e002:f14] We are grateful to CIC, GPF, INA, Khazanah, KWAP and SOFAZ for their trust, and look forward to building CAJIC into the corridor's leading sovereign investor platform." CAJIC was inaugurated at the 26th CIFIT in Xiamen on 8 September 2026. ** Source Latest News Digital & Technology WRISE Prestige Marks Two Years in Hong Kong with Strong Growth and Unveils the Evolution of the Inte... evidence.title: Sovereign Investment Institutions Launch China-ASEAN Joint Investment Council
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- China Investment Corporation ("CIC"), Government Pension Fund ("GPF") of Thailand, Indonesia Investment Authority ("INA"), Khazanah Nasional Berhad ("Khazanah") of Malaysia, and State Oil Fund of The Republic of Azerbaijan ("SOFAZ"), launched the China-ASEAN Joint Investment Council ("CAJIC" or "the Council") at the 26 th China International Fair for Investment and Trade ("CIFIT") in Xiamen. [e003:f02] Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (Diperbadankan) (KWAP) of Malaysia also joined CAJIC. [e003:f03] CAJIC is intended to provide a dedicated institutional platform through which long-term investors can deepen mutual understanding, develop cross-border investment opportunities, and form a more robust and sustainable China-ASEAN investment ecosystem. [e003:f04] CIC places great importance on cooperation with the sovereign investment institutions in the region to strengthen the cross-border investment ecosystem and promote two-way investment. [e003:f05] Regular dialogue and joint research can reduce information gaps, deepen understanding of local markets, and help institutions identify where their mandates and capabilities align. [e003:f06] Over time, this can strengthen investment pipelines and build trusted partnerships that extend beyond individual transactions. [e003:f07] Ultimately, CAJIC's value will lie in its ability to connect institutions, ideas, and opportunities, and translate them into investment collaboration that creates enduring value for China, ASEAN, and our respective stakeholders." Israfil Mammadov, CEO of SOFAZ, said, "For SOFAZ, CAJIC is a natural extension of our approach to building long-term partnerships with leading sovereign institutions and deepening our engagement across an increasingly important investment corridor. [e003:f08] We look forward to contributing SOFAZ's experience and perspective while developing partnerships that can create long-term value." Dr Soraphol Tulayasathien, Secretary-General of GPF, said, "As a long-term institutional investor, GPF sees growing opportunities across the China–ASEAN corridor, particularly in sustainable infrastructure, digitalization, advanced manufacturing and the low-carbon transition. [e003:f09] We look forward to turning shared knowledge into sound long-term investment decisions, supported by strong governance and disciplined risk management." Dato' Amirul Feisal Wan Zahir, Managing Director of Khazanah , said, "Khazanah is honoured to be part of the China-ASEAN Joint Investment Council, which comes at an important time for our region. [e003:f10] China and ASEAN are already deeply connected through trade, investment and supply chains, and the next phase of growth will require sustained dialogue, trusted partnerships and disciplined long-term capital. [e003:f11] Through CAJIC, we look forward to working with like-minded institutions to strengthen regional connectivity, deepen investment collaboration and support long-term prosperity across China and ASEAN." Wang Sheng, Chairman of CGS , said, "CAJIC extends CGS International's work in the China-ASEAN corridor from capital deployment through CAIP launched earlier this year, into the wider institutional platform where sovereign investors across the region can convene, research and collaborate. [e003:f12] We are grateful to CIC, GPF, INA, Khazanah, KWAP and SOFAZ for their trust, and look forward to building CAJIC into the corridor's leading sovereign investor platform." CAJIC was inaugurated at the 26 th CIFIT in Xiamen on 8 September 2026. [e003:f13] About China Investment Corporation Founded in 2007, Beijing-headquartered China Investment Corporation ("CIC") was established to diversify China's foreign exchange holdings and is one of the largest sovereign wealth funds in the world. [e003:f14] CIC's overseas investment activities include public equity and bond investments; hedge fund and multi-asset investments; industry-wide private equity and private credit investments; direct investments and fund investments in sectors such as real estate, infrastructure, resources and commodities, and agriculture; and managing bilateral and multilateral funds. [e003:f15] About Indonesia Investment Authority (INA) Indonesia Investment Authority is Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund mandated to increase investment to support the country's sustainable development and build wealth for its future generations. [e003:f16] INA conducts investment activities and collaborates with leading global and domestic investment institutions in sectors that strengthen Indonesia's advantages and provide risk-adjusted optimal returns.

evidence.title: 中国で科学的素養を持つ人々の割合が16．74％に上昇―2025年調査
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 中国科学技術協会が9月14日に明らかにしたところによると、同協会が中国の特色ある公民（中国国籍を有する人々）の科学的素養評価システムに基づき、2025年に実施した第15回全国調査によると、科学的素養を持つ人々の割合が16．74％に達したとのことです。 [e004:f02] これは、「全民科学的素養行動計画綱要（2021〜2035年）」で掲げられた2025年に15％を超えるという発展目標を1年以上前倒しで達成したことを示しています。 [e004:f03] 調査によると、中国の各地域、各層における科学的素養の発展の不均衡は明らかに改善され、発展の質は着実に向上しています。 [e004:f04] うち科学的素養を持つ都市部住民の割合は19．36％、農村部住民は12．02％に達し、都市と農村の格差は2年連続で縮小しました。 [e004:f05] 中国の18歳から69歳までの公民のうち、基本的な科学的素養を備えている割合は49．02％に達し、半数近くとなりました。 [e004:f06] また科学的素養を持つ層は16．74％、高いレベルの科学的素養を持つ層は2．50％に上昇しました。 [e004:f07] 調査によると、中国公民の科学技術イノベーションに対する支持度は著しく高まっています。 [e004:f08] 2025年に、「科学技術イノベーションに対する国民の理解と支持は、科学技術強国を建設するための基礎である」との考えに賛成した割合は85．4％に達し、2020年よりおよそ3ポイント上昇しました。 [e004:f09] 人工知能 （AI）は現在最も注目されている分野の一つとなっています。 [e004:f10] 調査では、AIに対する中国公民の受容度はさらに向上し、前向きな姿勢を示しています。 [e004:f11] AI技術をより多く日常生活に取り入れたいと回答した人は全体の73．2％、中国のAIの発展に自信を示した人は82．3％に上りました。 [e004:f12] （提供/ CGTN Japanese ） コメントを読む ※本記事はニュース提供社の記事であり、RecordChinaの立場を代表するものではありません。 [e004:f13] すべてのコンテンツの著作権は、ニュース提供社に帰属します。

evidence.title: What a Fed rate hike means for your bank accounts, loans, credit cards, and investments
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh and the Federal Open Market Committee announced a widely expected quarter-point rate increase and indicated another to come. [e002:f02] The stock market's reaction to the Fed's announcement is likely to draw the most headlines, and John Shugar, a partner at Goldman Sachs, leans toward an optimistic scenario. [e002:f03] Here's how to prepare for the impact on your deposits, credit, and debt. [e002:f04] The national average interest rate on checking accounts has barely budged this year, remaining at 0.07%. [e002:f05] A Fed short-term interest rate increase, whenever it comes, may nudge earnings incrementally higher. [e002:f06] This is one category where rate shopping and subsequent Fed rate increases really pay off. [e002:f07] The national average on a 12-month CD is 1.71%, but you can find better deals if you're willing to shop around — and move your money to the best offer. [e002:f08] Fed interest rate increases don't usually move mortgage rates directly — the bond market tends to price in hikes before monetary policy moves. [e002:f09] Dig deeper: Mortgage rate predictions for the next 5 years What a rate hike means for personal loans and student loans Personal loans Personal loan interest rates have risen slightly to an average of 11.86%. [e002:f10] That said, if the Fed's rate hikes successfully cool inflation, Treasury yields may drop — and the following year's federal student loan rates could be lower. [e002:f11] Private student loans are offered by banks, credit unions, and online lenders, many of which use the prime rate as a basis for setting their interest rates. [e002:f12] So, when the Fed raises rates, new private loan rates usually rise, and when it cuts rates, they tend to fall. [e002:f13] Rates have climbed from around 16% in 2021 to an average of over 22% toda Michele Raneri, vice president and head of U.S. research at TransUnion, expects consumers to see "minimally higher" borrowing costs as variable-rate credit products reflect the Fed's interest rate hike. [e002:f14] "A consumer carrying the average Q2 2026 credit card balance of $6,610 at a 22% APR could see an increase of $1.38 in minimum monthly payments as those higher rates are passed on," Raneri said in a statement. [e002:f15] Yahoo Personal Finance How the Fed's interest rate policy impacts your investments "There's an old Wall Street adage that says, 'Don't fight the Fed,'" Kevin Gordon, head of macro research and strategy at Schwab, said in an analysis. [e002:f16] "The idea behind it was that there's often a lot of turbulence associated with Fed rate-hiking cycles." He noted that history shows an average maximum loss of more than 10% for the S&P 500 sometime within 12 months after the start of a higher-interest-rate cycle.

evidence.title: The Fed raises rates for the first time in 3 years
evidence.body: [e005:f01] By Matty Merritt September 17, 2026 • less than 3 min read TOPICS: US Economy / Monetary Policy / Interest Rate Decisions In a clean sweep, the Fed’s Open Market Committee voted 12–0 to raise interest rates yesterday by a quarter point to the 3.75%–4% range. [e005:f02] It’s the first time the Fed has increased interest rates since July 2023—and most Fed officials expect to do so one more time this year, since inflation remains well above the Fed’s 2% target. [e005:f03] Everyone knew it was coming. [e005:f04] With the Fed’s preferred inflation measure showing July inflation holding strong at 3.7% compared to the same time last year, a separate measure of inflation also ratcheting up, and no end in sight for the war in Iran sending oil prices up, investors and economists would have been more surprised if Fed Chair Kevin Warsh didn’t announce a rate increase. [e005:f05] Still, it’s a big deal, since these rates set borrowing costs, affecting loans for individuals and businesses and everything from mortgage rates to AI investment. [e005:f06] But just because it was anticipated doesn’t mean there wasn’t drama. [e005:f07] The rate cut comes after President Trump has repeatedly called for rate cuts…and nominated Warsh as Jerome Powell’s successor assuming he’d deliver them: The hike was viewed as a positive sign for Fed independence, and Warsh dodged numerous questions during his post-announcement press conference about the president’s potential reaction. [e005:f08] Trump posted on social media claiming that rates should be at 1% “or less,” and urged the Fed to lower interest rates without calling out anyone in particular. [e005:f09] Much of the movement happened before the announcement, with mortgage rates and Treasury bond yields spiking, as markets anticipated rates would rise. [e005:f10] Become smarter in just 5 minutes Morning Brew delivers quick and insightful updates about the business world every day of the week from Wall St. to Silicon Valley.

evidence.title: Fed Raises Rates In Fight To Tame Inflation
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The Fed's rate hike aims to control inflation but raises borrowing costs, which is expected to impact real estate and economic growth. [e004:f02] First Rate Hike Since 2023 Lands Atop 5% Treasury Yield, Ratcheting Up Capital Pressure September 16, 2026 | 2:05 pm ET Matt Wasielewski, National Federal Open Market Committee members voted unanimously Wednesday to raise the Federal Reserve 's benchmark rate, an expected but significant shift in the central bank’s fight to tame inflation. [e004:f03] The decision is the first rate increase since July 2023 and ends a five-meeting string of votes to hold rates flat. [e004:f04] Investors started the year confident that the path forward from the FOMC in 2026 would be rate cuts, but stubbornly elevated inflation shifted expectations and forced the Fed to go the opposite route. [e004:f05] “Cap rate movement is unlikely to be unilateral — market by market, sector by sector — but certainly a trend toward higher capital costs will impact transactional volume.” In its statement released with the decision, the Fed said the economy remains relatively robust despite elevated uncertainty, and the central bank was clear that the move to raise rates was meant to target the pace of price hikes. [e004:f06] “Interest Rates in the United States should be 1% or less because we are the Best Credit in the World,” he wrote. [e004:f07] The central bank is tasked with price stability and maximum employment, and the move to raise the benchmark rate to a range between 3.75% and 4% represents its most aggressive attempt in years to tamp down inflation. [e004:f08] But the rate hike comes as investors already face a challenging debt environment, with yields on 10-year Treasury bonds surpassing the 5% mark and pushing up borrowing costs at the same time that delinquency rates are climbing . [e004:f09] “The impact of the recent rate increase will likely tame enthusiasm for any marginal development projects and could elevate capitalization rates,” Noel Liston , managing broker at Core Industrial Realty, said via email. [e004:f10] “However, the rate increase reinforces the Fed’s commitment to tame inflation and longer-term bond yields may not increase much if the market believes the pain of higher rates will be shorter in nature.” Yields on 10-year Treasury bonds jumped during Warsh’s press conference Wednesday and ended the day just above 5%. [e004:f11] Projections also moved toward a tighter labor market and a narrower expected range for inflation this year, coalescing around a 3.75% midpoint and staying above 3% across 2027. [e004:f12] Flickr/Federalreserve Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh and Governors Philip Jefferson and Michelle Bowman Wednesday’s decision to raise rates was expected, and the financial projections indicate another 25 bps hike is likely this year, Michael Pearce, chief U.S. economist at Oxford Economics, said in an email. [e004:f13] “We don’t think this is the beginning of another major tightening cycle and markets have too much tightening priced in over the coming year.” The consumer price index recorded 3.4% annualized inflation in August, up by 0.4% from the prior month and far from the central bank’s longtime 2% target. [e004:f14] The central bank opted to hold rates flat in Warsh’s first two meetings at the helm, but there were signs that a hike may be on the horizon. [e004:f15] Three FOMC members dissented in July in favor of a 25 bps hike, and Wednesday’s decision could help bolster the Fed’s independence after unprecedented interventions from the White House. [e004:f16] “The increase reinforced that the Fed remains focused on inflation, and is willing to maintain restrictive policy even as higher borrowing costs weigh on rate-sensitive sectors,” Andrew Koller, research analyst at Wolf Commercial Real Estate / CORFAC International , said in an email.

evidence.title: 米国の雇用が回復を示す、5月に非農業雇用が17.2万人増加 | ウクライナニュース - #Mezha
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 5月の雇用は予想を上回る伸びを示し、市場は再び活気づいた。 [e006:f02] Reuters〜の情報によると 米国経済は5月にも雇用の堅調な伸びを記録し、労働市場が昨年のつまずきの後再びペースを取り戻していることを示した。 [e006:f03] インフレの上昇が米国とイスラエル・イランの対立に関連しているとの見方がある中、FRBが据え置きに踏み切る余地を広げる可能性があるとみられる。 [e006:f04] 米労働省労働統計局が公表した最新の雇用統計によると、5月の非農業部門雇用者数は前月比17万2000人の増加となり、4月は改定値で17万9000人の増加だった。 [e006:f05] エコノミストはこの局面で、4月の上方改定を踏まえ、約8万5000人の増加を見込んでいた。 [e006:f06] 雇用の伸びの予測は、おおよそ5万〜12万5千人の幅で分かれていた。 [e006:f07] エコノミストは、労働力人口の増加に追いつくには月間でおおよそ0件から5万件程度の雇用創出が必要だと指摘している。 [e006:f08] 失業率は3か月連続で4.3％を示した。 [e006:f09] 雇用創出の伸びは主に解雇の低水準によるものとみられる一方、企業は過去の政権の関税措置と現在の地政学的緊張に伴う不確実性から新規採用を慎重に見ている。 [e006:f10] 企業利益は第1四半期に404億ドル増となり、2025年後半以降、持続的に増加している。 [e006:f11] 雇用創出が堅調なペースを維持している一方で、労働市場は依然として「緩やかな採用・緩やかな解雇」と呼ばれる状態にとどまっている。 [e006:f12] 金融市場は、FRBが政策金利を3.50％〜3.75％の水準で2027年まで据え置くとみられる。 [e006:f13] 役立つ読み物： 米国の雇用指標が改善の兆しを示している。 [e006:f14] 5月の非農業部門雇用は約8.5万増が予想され、ADPや求人件数も強さを示すがリスクは残る。 [e006:f15] 4月の米雇用は予想を上回る増加を記録し、失業率は4.3%で安定。 [e006:f16] 米国の新規失業保険申請が先週増加し4か月ぶりの高水準に達したが、基調は堅調で労働市場は概ね安定していると示唆されるニュース概要。

evidence.title: 米国の民間雇用が5月に12万2000人増えた、4月は下方修正 | ウクライナニュース - #Mezha
evidence.body: [e007:f01] ADPの数字は民間雇用の回復を示唆し、市場の関心を集めています。 [e007:f02] 公式統計との差異が今後の政策判断に影響を与える可能性があります。 [e007:f03] Reuters〜によると 米国の民間部門は成長を続けており、5月には民間部門の雇用が大幅に増加した。 [e007:f04] 4月の数値は、以前に報告された10万9000人から下方修正され、10万5000人となった。 [e007:f05] 評価のために行われた取材によると、4月に既に報じられた10万9000人を上回る、民間部門で約11万7千人の雇用増加を見込んだ。 [e007:f06] ADPの報告は、スタンフォード大学デジタル・エコノミー・ラボとの共同作業で作成され、5月のより包括的な雇用統計の発表を控えて公表される。 [e007:f07] なお、ADPデータは公式の雇用統計と必ずしも一致しないことがある。 [e007:f08] 労働市場は、関税をはじめとする外部要因による昨年の振れを経て回復の兆しを見せている。 [e007:f09] エコノミストの予測によると、5月の総雇用の増加は約8万5千人程度とみられ、4月の11万5千人の増加に続く見込みだ。 [e007:f10] 失業率は4.3％前後にとどまると見込まれている。 [e007:f11] 金融市場は、FRBが来年まで少なくとも3.50％–3.75％の政策金利を維持すると見ており、インフレの動向と戦争が物価・経済へ及ぼす影響を慎重に見極めている。 [e007:f12] 政府統計は、4月にインフレが過去3年で最も速いペースで上昇したことを示しており、金融政策と物価動向の見通しに新たな重荷を課している。 [e007:f13] 今後の展望 今後の雇用統計は、労働市場の実態をより詳しく示すとともに、インフレ圧力の中で経済が成長を続けるかどうかを見極める材料となる。 [e007:f14] ぜひ注目していただきたい内容： 米国の初回失業保険申請が5千件増加し21万5000件に。 [e007:f15] 継続給付も上昇、テック業界の解雇や中東情勢が労働市場とインフレに影響を及ぼしています。 [e007:f16] 4月の米雇用は115千人増で失業率は4.3%にとどまったが、業種偏重や賃金と物価の変動が市場の潜在的な弱さを示している。

evidence.title: FRB、2023年7月以来初の利上げ 物価上昇の拡大防ぐため
evidence.body: [e001:f01] 年初以降、イランとの戦争を背景にインフレが加速する中、物価上昇を抑える取り組みを再び強化した。 [e001:f02] 当局者らは、政策金利を0.25ポイント引き上げ、3.75～4％とすることを決めた。 [e001:f03] これにより、昨年実施した3回の利下げのうち1回分が打ち消される形となった。 [e001:f04] この決定は、中東で数カ月にわたり続く戦争がエネルギー価格を大きく揺さぶり、インフレをより長期化、広範化させる恐れが強まる中で下された。 [e001:f05] 当局者らは、人工知能（AI）関連の大規模な設備投資がインフレに及ぼす可能性についても懸念を抱いている。 [e001:f06] 今回の利上げは、ウォーシュFRB議長の下で初となる金利政策上の大きな動きである。 [e001:f07] ウォーシュ氏は同日、インフレの主因となっているエネルギー価格の上昇そのものを抑える実質的な手段を中央銀行は持っていないことを認めた。 [e001:f08] 記者団に対し、「原油価格であれ食品価格であれ、個別の価格に我々が影響を及ぼすことはできない」と述べた。 [e001:f09] その上で、今回の0.25ポイントの利上げについて、物価上昇がこれ以上広範囲に波及するのを防ぐためのものだと説明した。 [e001:f10] FRBがインフレ指標として個人消費支出（PCE）物価指数を重視する理由の一つは、消費者物価指数（CPI）に比べて幅広く物価動向を捉える指標と見なされているからだ。 [e001:f11] 当局者らは特に、食品とエネルギーを除いた基調的なインフレ指標である「コア指数」に注目している。 [e001:f12] メールマガジン登録 見過ごしていた 世界の動き が 一目でわかる evidence.body: [e002:f01] 」 ニューヨーク - 火曜日（9月15日）、原油価格の上昇がインフレ懸念を強めた後、金価格は下落しました。 [e002:f02] この状況は、FRBの利上げ期待をさらに強め、中央銀行の政策会合を前に米国債利回りも押し上げました。 [e002:f03] ロイターの引用によると 、スポット金価格はGMT11時10分に0.4%下落し、1トロイオンスあたりUS$4,282.49となりました。 [e002:f04] 金価格は月曜日（9月14日）に8月7日以来の安値を付けました。 [e002:f05] 一方、米国金先物価格は0.7%下落し、1トロイオンスあたりUS$4,323.30となりました。 [e002:f06] Read Also: 銅価格1.1%上昇、中国のバイヤーが買い戻し サクソバンクの商品戦略責任者、オレ・ハンセン氏は、「金価格への圧力は、原油価格の上昇、水曜日（9月16日）に市場にほぼ完全に織り込まれているとみられる米国の利上げ期待、ドル高、および長期債利回りの上昇が組み合わさった結果です」と述べました。 [e002:f07] ハンセン氏によると、現在の下降圧力を和らげるためには、金価格は1トロイオンスあたりUS$4,440を再び突破する必要があります。 [e002:f08] FRBは水曜日（9月16日）のGMT18時に金融政策決定を発表します。 [e002:f09] CME FedWatch Toolによると、市場参加者は現在、25ベーシスポイントの利上げ確率が92%に達すると予想しています。 [e002:f10] 同時に、米国10年物国債利回りは2007年以来の高水準に上昇しました。 [e002:f11] サウジアラビアのエネルギーインフラへの攻撃によりイースト・ウエスト・パイプラインが停止した後も、供給途絶の懸念が残る中、原油価格は2%近く上昇しました。 [e002:f12] イエメン当局者によると、イエメンのイランが支援するフーシ派グループは、サウジアラビアへの一連の攻撃を再び開始し、紅海に面するイエメンの西海岸沿いでその地位を強化しました。 [e002:f13] 他の貴金属市場では、スポット銀価格は0.1%下落し、1トロイオンスあたりUS$63.16となりました。 [e002:f14] プラチナ価格は0.4%上昇しUS$1,765.70、一方パラジウムは0.1%わずかに上昇し、1トロイオンスあたりUS$1,293.95となりました。 [e002:f15] （ARF） Add as a preferred source on Google Read Also 日本の個人投資家は円高に懐疑的 1%+持株モニター 上場企業の1%以上の持株比率を持つ株主を簡単にモニタリング。 [e002:f16] 17 Sep 2026 09:40 中国中央銀行、貸出需要の減速に注目 17 Sep 2026 08:40 BRMS、パル地下金鉱の2027年稼働を目指す 17 Sep 2026 08:00 # Hot Topic Indonesia the US JCI stocks アメリカ合衆国 China 中国 Iran index イラン 人気ニュース フィッチ：日本の利回り上昇は国内機関資金を国内に留める可能性 12 Sep 2026 15:00 米国債10年物利回り5%に迫る、アジア株は再び下落 11 Sep 2026 11:40 ホルムズ緊迫化、ブレントとWTI原油価格が6%以上急騰 11 Sep 2026 11:00 トランプ、銅関税を保留、ホワイトハウスは価格上昇リスクを懸念 11 Sep 2026 13:05 米国のディーゼル価格が24.1%急騰、生産者物価指数は年率5.4%上昇 11 Sep 2026 14:40。

evidence.title: 〔FOMC〕FRB議長：経済の強さ踏まえ利上げ＝物価安定へ正しい決定☆差替
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 物価安定の実現に向けて「正しい決定だ」と強調した。 [e004:f02] ウォーシュ氏は、直近のインフレ指標について「基調的なトレンドは大きく改善していない」と明言。 [e004:f03] 広範な金融環境も「引き締め的とは言い難い」と分析した。 [e004:f04] 雇用情勢は安定しているとして 、利上げを通じて「（責務である）物価安定に集中することができる」と言明した。 [e004:f05] FRBは今回の金融政策会合で、年内あと1回の追加利上げシナリオを示した。 [e004:f06] ただ、政策見通しを語ることに否定的なウォーシュ氏は「予断しない」と述べるにとどめた。 [e004:f07] 【関連記事】 【特集】円安「再起動」備える年に◆アメリカは「利下げの終わり」焦点◆2025年のドル・円相場◇みずほ銀行チーフマーケット・エコノミスト 唐鎌大輔 【特集】25年の日本株は「嵐の先に晴れ間」◆年末に最高値、4万3000円も◇第一生命経済研究所首席エコノミスト 熊野英生 利上げ是非、12月会合で判断 遅れれば「混乱」―日銀総裁 追加利上げ、今月も議論 物価目標「かなり近づく」―日銀総裁 米金利、4会合連続据え置きへ 年内利下げ見送りも―新議長初のFOMC。
